It explicitly frames the observed patient-control vigilance pattern as a qualified replication. records.omission_quote: Thus, the presented study showed that MDD patients were less likely to have decreasing vigilance over time compared to healthy controls. While this is not a straightforward replication, as previous studies focused on the percentage of vigilance stages, our findings still indicate an overall higher vigilance in patients.
